newsitem.title: USA: CHS sees acquisition accretive to EPS.
newsitem.headline: CHS sees acquisition accretive to EPS.

text.p: CHS Electronics Inc said Monday it expected its $160 million acquisition of Karma International SA to improve its bottom line.
"CHS expects this acquisition to be accretivwe to its earnings per share," CHS said in a statement.
In 1996 privately-held Karma posted $700 million in revenues, $18.5 million in operating earnings and $15.1 million in net profits, the statement added.

"The acquisition adds more than $500 million in yearly sales in Germany, France and the U.K., thereby strengthening our position as Europe's No. 2 distributor of micro computer products," said CHS chief executive Claudio Osorio in a statement.

CHS posted net earnings of $12.2 million on revenues of $1.86 billion in 1996, nearly doubling its earnings per share to $1.16 over the year before. In the first quarter ended March 31, CHS returned $0.44 per share, compared with $0.24 the year before.

CHS said on June 4 it bought four privately-held distribution companies in South America and Eastern Europe for an undisclosed amount of cash and stock. Like today, CHS said it expected the acquisition to boost net income.
A First Call estimate of two brokers put CHS' earnings per share at $0.34 for the second quarter ending June 30 and $1.76 for the year. CHS opened at 26-1/4 Friday, up 1/2.
